name: @pipeworx/mcp-eur-lex

tools.name: compliance_index
tools.description: Resolve a common EU regulation name to its CELEX id. Returns the curated map of the EU digital/compliance corpus (GDPR, NIS2, DORA, AI Act, DSA, DMA, eIDAS, Cyber Resilience Act, Data Act, …) with CELEX ids, types, dates and one-line summaries. Use this first to turn a name like "GDPR" into the CELEX id the other tools need.

query.description: Optional filter — name/alias/keyword (e.g. "AI Act", "data"). Omit to list the whole corpus.

tools.name: search_legislation
tools.description: Full-text search of EU legislation titles via the EUR-Lex SPARQL endpoint. Returns CELEX id, English title and document date. Use when the act is not in compliance_index, or to find related/amending acts.

query.description: Keyword(s) that must appear in the English title, e.g. "cybersecurity certification".

type.description: Optional: restrict to a legal act type.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Fetch title, document date, legal type, in-force status hint, and EUR-Lex citation URL for one EU act by CELEX id (e.g. "32016R0679") or alias (e.g. "GDPR"); does not download full text.

celex.description: CELEX id, e.g. "32016R0679", or a known alias like "GDPR".

lang.description: ISO 639-2/B language code for the title (default "eng": eng, fra, deu, spa, ita, …).

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Table of contents for an act: every Article number and its heading. Use to discover which Article to quote before calling get_article.

celex.description: CELEX id or a known alias (e.g. "DORA").

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Full text of one or more Articles of an act, with a verifiable EUR-Lex citation URL for each. THE article-level grounding tool: quote GDPR Art. 17, AI Act Art. 6, etc. Accepts a single number ("17"), a comma list ("5,6,17") or a range ("5-9").

celex.description: CELEX id or a known alias (e.g. "GDPR").

article.description: Article selector: "17", "5,6,17", or "5-9". Suffixed numbers like "9a" are supported.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Plain-text of a whole act (recitals + enacting terms), paged. Use for short acts or to read recitals/definitions; for a specific Article prefer get_article. Returns up to max_chars from offset.

celex.description: CELEX id or a known alias.

offset.description: Character offset to start from, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: cjeu_search
tools.description: Search EU COURT JUDGMENTS — the case law of the Court of Justice (CJEU) and the General Court — by subject. Returns the case, the court, the date and the CELEX id to read it with. Use for "what has the CJEU said about data protection", "EU court rulings on gatekeepers", or to find the judgment interpreting a Regulation. This is case law; search_legislation covers the Regulations and Directives themselves.

query.description: Words appearing in the case title, e.g. "data protection", "state aid", "trade mark".

court.description: Limit to a court: "cjeu" (Court of Justice) or "general" (General Court). Default: both.

include_notices.description: Include short Official Journal notices about judgments as well as the judgments themselves (default false).

tools.name: cjeu_judgment
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of an EU court judgment from its case number — "C-97/23", "T-144/25" — or its CELEX id. Resolves the case number people actually cite into the document. Use after cjeu_search, or whenever a case number appears in a filing or article.

case_number.description: As cited, e.g. "C-97/23" (Court of Justice) or "T-144/25" (General Court). A CELEX id like "62023CJ0097" also works.

offset.description: Character offset, for paging through a long judgment (default 0).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-eur-lex forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the eur-lex pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
